//: The scheduler: a Railway cron service, committed for the same reason railway.json is —
a schedule that exists only in somebody's dashboard is a schedule nobody can review
and nobody can restore. Create a second service in the same Railway project, point its
config file at THIS file, and set two variables on it:
ECE_SCHEDULER_LIVE=yes      — without it every run is a dry run that sends nothing
Daily at 20:00 UTC, which is 08:00 NZST / 09:00 NZDT — after the morning drop-off has
started, before the office sits down. The job is idempotent by construction (the
planner reads its own ledger: one ask per calendar week, three per period), so a
daily tick is safe and a missed day costs one day, not a duplicate.
Cron here is UTC and this repo's rule about New Zealand mornings cuts the OTHER way
for once: 20:00 UTC is always the NEXT New Zealand morning, on both sides of
daylight saving, so the centre-calendar day the job computes is stable at this hour.

build.buildCommand: npm run build -w @ece/core && npm run build -w @ece/api
